digest.component_or_area: live-DC readiness (Jira integration workflows and test harness)
propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls /rest/api/2/serverInfo until HTTP 200 but does not verify that required Jira Software custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) have registered, allowing a timing flake where plugin fields are not yet available despite the readiness check passing.
A system-only field inventory (no customfield_* entries) is treated as ready rather than not-ready, conflating the early-startup state with a degraded image.
The harness and probe workflows use different readiness definitions: the harness polls serverInfo only while the probe also waits for field inventory, creating drift that violates AC4.

The _assert_project_capabilities fixture asserts the required fields too late to serve as a readiness gate, and its failure message conflates a timing flake (not-registered-yet) with a genuine image degrade (not-offered-by-image).
The readiness check must poll /rest/api/2/field under a bounded budget and fail with a self-diagnosing inventory dump when required fields do not arrive, not merely on serverInfo 200.
